citation: Smith K, et al. The Postprandial Glycaemic and Hormonal Responses Following the Ingestion of a Novel, Ready-to-Drink Shot Containing a Low Dose of Whey Protein in Centrally Obese and Lean Adult Males. Front Endocrinol 2021.
protocol: Overnight fast; breakfast of 60 g cereal and 250 mL whole milk (387 kcal, 58% carbohydrate, 27% fat, 15% protein) 10 min after 100 mL water (placebo) or a 15 g whey shot; samples to 240 min
population: n=12 lean and n=12 centrally obese men
note: The water arm of the lean men is the usable one. Areas to 240 min are in a table; point values may be figure-only.
